neighbours.label: an item one must have, wear or show in order to be allowed or able to do something (need a permit, wear a helmet, show a badge): fires on the item or its article; the same scenes without a required item stay quiet
fire: To use the reading room you will need a library card.
Nobody gets into the lab without a security badge.
Cyclists on the mountain trail are required to wear a helmet.
Before you can fish in the lake you must buy a licence.
Guests have to show a wristband to get into the pool area.
You can't board the ferry unless you have a boarding pass.
Workers handling the acid must put on protective goggles first.
To drive the forklift you need a special certificate.
quiet: The reading room is quiet in the mornings and crowded after lunch.
Nobody in the lab noticed the rain until the evening.
Cyclists on the mountain trail often stop to admire the view.
Before the sun came up we walked down to the lake.
Guests were talking and laughing beside the pool all afternoon.
The ferry crossed the bay slowly in the fog.
Workers poured the acid carefully into a glass tank.
He drove the forklift across the yard and parked it.
